layman_headline: Time to lock in profits on Hyperliquid — it's nearly hit the target price.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market is surging right now — Bitcoin is up 24% in a week and most altcoins have jumped 30-70%. Two of your holdings are doing great: Hyperliquid is up 14% and nearly at its all-time high, and Solana is up 10.6% approaching its $100 target. When everything rallies this fast, smart traders take profits before the inevitable pullback. HYPE is essentially at target — no reason to get greedy.
layman_action: Sell Hyperliquid now to lock in the ~14% gain. Continue holding Solana with its stop-loss at $77. Wait for a market cooldown before opening new positions — everything is extended right now.
expert_reasoning: HYPE at $82.04 is 98.8% of the way to its $83 exit target and only 0.5% from ATH — this is textbook profit-taking territory. The broader market is in a sharp relief rally with Fear & Greed at 71 (Greed), up from a weekly average of 51. Every swing candidate shows massively extended 7-day moves with negative composite signal scores. BTC dominance at 58.5% continues to suppress alt performance on a relative basis. No new entries make sense when RSI readings that exist (TRUMP at 29.6, XRP at 31.6) are paradoxically low despite 60-88% weekly gains — suggesting these RSI readings may be lagging or unreliable on this timeframe. SOL should be held with the $77 stop intact as it approaches its $100 target.
